blocking: The descending tree extends behind the central cards in desktop screenshot 2, breaking the required open middle.

fixes.what: Clip or mask the tree into edge strips that stay outside the content column at every breakpoint.
fixes.why: The supplied desktop screenshot shows foliage behind central content, violating the framing rule.

fixes.what: Add data-lenis-prevent to the scrollable panel and overscroll-behavior:contain; verify wheel, touch and keyboard scrolling reach its final links while background scrolling stays locked.
fixes.why: The dialog must remain scrollable when Lenis is stopped, especially on short screens.

fixes.where: assets/js/site.js — section reveals; index.html — inquiry form
fixes.what: Keep the form visible independently of reveal animation, and immediately reveal any animated ancestor when a descendant receives keyboard focus.
fixes.why: Opacity does not remove controls from the tab order; keyboard users can encounter invisible focus.

fixes.what: Use var(--ruby) or var(--sage) for the founder attribution on parchment.
fixes.why: Gold on parchment is approximately 2.3:1, below the 4.5:1 requirement for this small text.

fixes.where: assets/css/site.css — mobile navigation and script-failure fallbacks
fixes.what: Show mobile navigation links by default; collapse them only after navigation handlers have successfully initialized, and hide nonfunctional controls until then.
fixes.why: Without site.js, mobile visitors lose access to Weddings, How we work and About despite the content fallback.

fixes.what: Add an AbortController timeout, restore the submit button in finally, and preserve entered values with a retry message after timeout.
